item.title: 1.40.8b2
item.description:
⚠️ BETA RELEASE WARNING

This is an unstable pre-release version intended for testing purposes only.

✨ New Features

  • Window Gestures: manage windows with trackpad gestures
    • Turn it on in Settings > Gestures, then accept the restart prompt
    • Gestures need "Zoom in or out" and "Smart zoom" enabled in System Settings > Trackpad for pinch and double-tap
    • An orange notice with an Open Trackpad Settings button appears if either is off
  • Window Gestures on a window's title bar
    • Two fingers on the title bar: swipe left or right to snap to a half, swipe up to fill the screen
    • Swipe sideways, then up or down, to snap to a corner
    • Swipe down to minimize, pinch out for full screen, double-tap to center
    • Pinch in to close the window, or just the tab in browsers and other tabbed apps
    • Windows with custom title bars respond in the top strip of the window
    • Drag a snapped window by its title bar to return it to its original size
    • Drag the shared edge between snapped windows to resize both
  • Window Gestures on Dock icons
    • Two fingers on an app's Dock icon: swipe down to minimize
    • Swipe up to restore the last minimized window, or bring the app forward if none is minimized
    • Pinch in to quit the app
  • Window Gestures on the menu bar
    • Two fingers on an empty menu bar area: swipe left or right for the previous or next app
    • Hold, then swipe, to open the window switcher; lift to select, press Esc to cancel
    • Swipe down or up to minimize or restore all windows on that display
  • New Gestures tab with a redesigned Window Gestures page
    • Settings > Gestures replaces the combined Gestures & Keybinds page
    • A headline on/off switch sits above a looping animated demo
    • Each gesture has its own row with a description and on/off switch
    • Hover a row to play its demo
    • Rows are grouped under On a Window's Title Bar, On a Dock Icon, and On the Menu Bar
  • Options for Window Gestures
    • Settings > Gestures > Options: Sensitivity, a preview of where the window will land, and haptic feedback
    • A tooltip next to the pointer shows the action about to happen, with the snap region or app icon
  • Back up and restore settings
    • Settings > General > Backup & Restore > Export Settings… saves a JSON file
    • Import Settings… replaces your current settings and restarts DockDoor
    • A confirmation shows how many settings will be restored and warns if the backup is from a different version
    • Clear errors appear if a file isn't a DockDoor backup or can't be read or saved
    • Searching Settings for "backup", "export", "restore", or "migrate" finds both options
  • Reserve screen space for a third-party dock
    • Settings > Gestures > Space for a Custom Dock
    • Choose Off, Bottom, Left, Right, or Top, and set a size from 10 to 300 px
    • Reserved space is capped at 40% of the screen
    • Snapped windows and window positioning stay clear of the strip
    • Dock apps can report their own space, listed under Reported by Apps
    • Scripts can also reserve space with AppleScript, for example reserve screen edge "bottom" thickness 80 for "com.example.MyDock" on display "main"
    • Reservations are released when the reporting app quits
  • Swipe Sensitivity for the trackpad window switcher
    • Settings > Gestures > More Gestures > Swipe Sensitivity, from 0.5 to 2
    • Higher values respond to shorter swipes; the default of 1 is unchanged
  • New Works with DockDoor page featuring Parall

🔧 Improvements & Stability

  • Gestures are easier to find and manage
    • Dock icon scroll, title bar scroll, dock preview swipes, and the trackpad window switcher swipe are under Settings > Gestures > More Gestures
    • Scroll gestures are dimmed while Window Gestures is on, since it handles those areas
    • Settings search now points gesture results to the Gestures tab
  • Settings > Keybinds is now its own page
    • It holds mouse actions, Cmd-key shortcuts, and window switcher keybinds
  • Window Gestures only loads when enabled
    • Turning it on or off prompts a restart, and it uses no resources while off
  • Snapped windows leave room for Stage Manager
    • Applies to all DockDoor window positioning, not just gestures
    • Works when the Dock is on the left, too
  • Centering a window is more reliable
    • Windows larger than the screen shrink to fit
    • Previously snapped windows return to their original size
  • Snap previews no longer glitch on very small windows
  • Gesture feedback is more accurate
    • Gestures over Dock icons are detected more reliably, including on multiple displays
    • The tooltip appears in the right place on multi-display setups
    • Esc cancels a gesture more reliably
  • Minimize and restore gestures keep your window list accurate
    • Window previews and the switcher stay up to date after a gesture
    • Minimize all and Restore all only affect the current Space and the display under your cursor
    • Restore all brings the most recently used window to the front

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • DockDoor launches normally again on macOS 26
  • Window switcher returns to the tab you selected in tabbed apps like Finder and Terminal
  • Window positions and sizes are recorded more accurately for the switcher and previews
  • Switcher order is no longer disturbed by background apps
  • Active App Indicator stays in place while a Dock icon bounces
    • Applies with the Dock at the bottom, left, or right
  • Leftover reserved screen space no longer affects snapping after a dock app quits
